Welcome to my channel! I am excited to help you ease pain, relieve anxiety, and move freely. Here, you will find self-massages, relaxation exercises, and many other tools that will empower you to improve your health and feel your best.

Please subscribe, hit the notifications bell, and join my membership for perks. Leave me a comment letting me know which videos helped you most, and what else you would like to see on my channel.

I am a New York State Licensed and Board Certified massage therapist, with a private practice in Manhattan. I am also the author of Amazon best-sellers, Hungry for Life and Glass Half Broken.

Disclaimer: This content is for educational purposes only and is not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Participation is voluntary and at your own risk. Please consult a qualified healthcare provider before beginning any exercise, stretching, breathing, meditation, or self-massage program. Stop if you experience pain, dizziness, or worsening symptoms.
